data.name: Catching Breaks
data.detailed_description:
Catching Breaks is a darkly funny office simulator where everything falls apart - usually right after you’ve fixed it.

In this corporate paradise, you are the unsung hero (or the only person with a pulse) holding the workplace together. Whether it's a printer spewing fire or a coffee machine staging a revolution, your to-do list is a never-ending nightmare of chaos and "urgent" requests.

  • The Struggle is Real: Repair broken office equipment with a variety of tools before the whole floor descends into anarchy.

  • Social Stealth: Master the art of the "Dodge and Weave" to avoid chatty coworkers who want to tell you about their weekend or a receptionist ready to lecture you on "Office Conduct."

  • Combat Small Talk: Literally fight your way through awkward conversations and productivity-killing meetings.

  • Survive the Grind: Manage your stress levels while putting out literal and metaphorical fires.

Can you survive another productive day, or will the weight of the corporate machine finally crush your spirit? Remember: no matter how good you are, these people will always find a way to break something.

data.short_description: Catching Breaks is a darkly comedic office simulator where fixing problems is easy and dealing with people is not. Repair broken machines while coworkers interrupt you with pointless conversations, fake urgency, and corporate nonsense. Keep the office running long enough to survive another workday.
